note:
- LANDMARK FRAME COVENT GARDEN generated the highest revenue TW at £3,766.4, followed by LANDMARK FRAME OXFORD STREET at £3,753.9.
- LANDMARK FRAME NOTTING HILL achieved £3,660.0 revenue TW, while LANDMARK FRAME LONDON BRIDGE and LANDMARK FRAME BAKER STREET generated £3,603.9 and £3,447.5 respectively.
- GINGHAM HEART DECORATION led unit sales TW with 2,130 units, significantly ahead of 60 CAKE CASES VINTAGE CHRISTMAS at 1,551 units.
- MINI PAINT SET VINTAGE sold 1,334 units TW, with MINI PLAYING CARDS SPACEBOY and MINI PLAYING CARDS DOLLY GIRL achieving 1,256 and 1,217 units respectively.
- HOT WATER BOTTLE KEEP CALM recorded the highest order count TW at 50 orders, matched by PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS and JUMBO BAG 50'S CHRISTMAS at 48 orders each.
- CERAMIC CAKE STAND + HANGING CAKES showed the strongest WoW revenue growth at 2,392.0 percent, with GINGHAM HEART DECORATION at 2,054.1 percent WoW.
- RED HARMONICA IN BOX demonstrated exceptional YoY revenue growth of 26,576.5 percent, while PLASTERS IN TIN WOODLAND ANIMALS grew 14,136.1 percent YoY.
- SOMBRERO achieved 4,173.5 percent YoY revenue growth, with ROUND SNACK BOXES SET OF4 WOODLAND and SET/10 RED POLKADOT PARTY CANDLES growing 1,006.0 percent and 609.8 percent YoY respectively.

calls.system:
You are a data analyst who writes short, correct pandas code.

Write one Python script that:
- reads the CSV file whose path is given in sys.argv[1] with pandas,
- computes up to 25 facts that would be most useful for a weekly executive insight note (largest entities, biggest week over week and year over year movers, shares, totals),
- prints one JSON array to stdout and nothing else.

Each element of the array is an object with these keys:
- "entity": the Entity value, or "TOTAL" for all rows combined.
- "metric": one of revenue, units, orders, share, rank.
- "period": one of TW, LW, LY, WoW, YoY. Use WoW or YoY for changes between periods.
- "value": a plain number (not a string). Round money to 2 decimals and percentages to 1 decimal.
- "formula": a short description of how the value was computed, for example "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100".

Use only pandas, numpy, json and sys. Blank cells are NaN: skip them instead of crashing. Convert numpy numbers to Python floats before json.dumps.
Return only the code, inside one ```python block.
calls.user:
The script will be run as: python facts.py table.csv

The CSV holds a weekly sales report for ISO week 2011-W42. Entity type: product. It has 125 rows and these columns (with pandas dtypes):
- Entity: str
- Revenue_TW: float64
- Revenue_LW: float64
- Revenue_LY: float64
- Units_TW: int64
- Units_LW: int64
- Orders_TW: int64
- Orders_LW: int64
- WoW_Pct: float64
- YoY_Pct: float64
- Share_Pct: float64
- Rank: int64

Column guide:
- Entity: the country or product.
- Revenue_TW, Revenue_LW, Revenue_LY: revenue in GBP for this week, last week, and the same ISO week last year (blank when that week is not in the data).
- Units_TW, Units_LW: units sold this week and last week.
- Orders_TW, Orders_LW: distinct invoices this week and last week.
- WoW_Pct: revenue percent change this week versus last week (blank when last week was zero).
- YoY_Pct: revenue percent change this week versus the same week last year (blank when not available).
- Share_Pct: this entity's percent share of this week's revenue across the rows shown.
- Rank: rank by this week's revenue among the rows shown (1 is highest).


First rows of the file:

calls.system:
You are a retail analyst who writes the weekly executive insight note for senior leaders. You are given a list of facts that were already computed from the sales table. Use only these facts. Every number in the note must come from a fact value, copied exactly or rounded (for example £12,345.67 may be written as £12.3k). Do not compute new numbers.

Format rules for the note:
- Write 6 to 8 bullet lines. Start each line with "- " and state exactly one insight per line.
- Every line names at least one entity from the data and contains at least one number.
- Label every period explicitly: TW (this week), LW (last week), LY (same ISO week last year), WoW (week over week change), YoY (year over year change).
- Revenue is in GBP. Write money with the £ sign.
- State facts only. Do not give recommendations, advice, or explanations of causes.
- Plain text only. No title, no headings, no markdown tables, no bold, no text before or after the bullets.
- Do not use em dashes.
